description: Browse an Ohio Administrative Code chapter: lists every rule number, heading and effective date in the chapter (e.g. chapter "3701-32" is the Department of Health lead hazard abatement rules). With query, returns only the rules whose heading or text matches the words, with an excerpt, so you can find the rule before calling oh_admin_rule. A chapter that does not exist answers found:false. Keyless.

query.description: Optional words to find within the chapter (rule headings and text).

name: oh_admin_chapter
title: Oh Admin Chapter
